events.title: US-Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The US-Iran conflict is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and the stock market. The situation is being closely monitored by global leaders.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict escalation could lead to increased oil prices, which would negatively impact the oil and gas exploration and production sector. On the other hand, the S&P 500 ETF could see a boost due to safe-haven demand.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and conflict developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/barrel or if conflict de-escalation is announced
